name: Two-Season Strand
description: Repair one coloured strand so its deterministic Spring and Winter fold maps both exactly cover their visible ghost blueprints. Switch the visible SPRING and WINTER view tabs to inspect each live fold. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. Do not switch to or interact with any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only when it is part of the task and only through its visible controls.
natural_language: Repair the 64-bead strand so both Spring and Winter fold maps exactly match their ghost blueprints. Switch the visible season tabs to inspect both live folds. Each edit refolds the whole strand; at least four of the six coupled repairs initially improve one season while regressing the other. Reconcile them within eighteen changed beads, then seal both seasons. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. metadata.source_notes: Original dual-fold strand workbench grounded in Eterna's live sequence refolding, exact target-structure tasks, and multi-state design problems; no source presentation or asset is copied.
metadata.notes: The browser refolds the edited strand under two visible deterministic orders; the server and exported verifier independently replay every edit and both pair sets.
